name: GOV catch-all: any successful tx touching a mf-privileged contract
description: Minimal-alert alternative: ONE alert instead of one per event. Fires on every successful transaction that touches a contract tagged mf-privileged and hands it to the privChangeGuard Web3 Action, which finds and decodes the governance logs itself. Use it only on quiet admin contracts: it runs the action on every touching tx. Notifications come from the action (Slack), not from this alert.
